title: Catching Bugs Before They Land: JiTTesting’s Human-on-the-Loop Approach at Full Scale
summary:

title: Python Typing Survey 2026: AI Tools and the Shifting Checker Landscape
summary:
The 2026 Python Typing Survey received 1,794 responses.  Type hint use changed little across three years, but checker selection changed sharply.  Among respondents who reported which checkers they use, half selected more than one, and missing library type information was the most common difficulty. title: The Thin Orchestrator: How We Made Our AI Agents More Reliable by Giving the Router Less to Do
summary:
